ucs.title: [LLM] ALPHV/BlackCat Rust encryptor launch via --access-token with recovery inhibition
ucs.description: Hunts the BlackCat (ALPHV/Noberus) Rust encryptor, which refuses to run without a per-victim '--access-token' and is characteristically launched alongside shadow-copy deletion and symlink-evaluation changes. The access-token gate plus the encryptor's bespoke flag set ('--paths', '--propagation', '--no-prop-servers', '--bypass', '--no-wall') is near-unique to this RaaS family and not seen in generic LockBit/Conti tradecraft.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*--access-token *" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers *" OR Processes.process="*--propagation*" OR Processes.process="*--no-wall*" OR Processes.process="*--bypass*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$")
| join type=outer dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*fsutil*SymlinkEvaluation*") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename count as recovery_inhibit_count]
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process recovery_inhibit_count count
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Encryptor = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "--access-token"
         or ProcessCommandLine has "--no-prop-servers"
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "--propagation" and ProcessCommandLine has "--paths")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "--bypass" and ProcessCommandLine has "--no-wall")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let RecoveryInhibit = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled")
         or (FileName =~ "fsutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "SymlinkEvaluation")
    | project DeviceId, RecoveryTime = Timestamp, RecoveryCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
Encryptor
| join kind=leftouter RecoveryInhibit on DeviceId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, RecoveryCmd
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Encryptor = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine has "--access-token"
         or TargetProcessCommandLine has "--access-token"
         or ActingProcessCommandLine has "--no-prop-servers"
         or (ActingProcessCommandLine has "--propagation" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "--paths")
         or (ActingProcessCommandLine has "--bypass" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "--no-wall")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let RecoveryInhibit = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where (TargetProcessName has "vssadmin" and TargetProcessCommandLine has "delete" and TargetProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
         or (TargetProcessName has "wmic" and TargetProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and TargetProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (TargetProcessName has "bcdedit" and TargetProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled")
         or (TargetProcessName has "fsutil" and TargetProcessCommandLine has "SymlinkEvaluation")
    | project DvcHostname, RecoveryTime = TimeGenerated, RecoveryCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine;
Encryptor
| join kind=leftouter RecoveryInhibit on DvcHostname
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256, RecoveryCmd
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: ALPHV/BlackCat Ransomware Encryptor Command-Line Flags
id: 6c2a9d41-7f3b-4f1e-9a2c-b1d3e5f70a21
status: experimental
description: Detects the BlackCat (ALPHV/Noberus) Rust encryptor by its bespoke access-token and propagation command-line arguments.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|contains: '--access-token'
  selection_combo:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '--propagation'
      - '--paths'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--no-prop-servers'
      - '--no-wall'
      - '--bypass'
  condition: selection_token or selection_combo or selection_flags
falsepositives:
  - Highly unlikely; these flag combinations are specific to the ALPHV encryptor
level: critical
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1490
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@CommandLine:*--access-token* OR @CommandLine:*--no-prop-servers* OR (@CommandLine:*--propagation* AND @CommandLine:*--paths*) OR (@CommandLine:*--bypass* AND @CommandLine:*--no-wall*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/--access-token|--no-prop-servers|--no-wall/i OR (CommandLine=/--propagation/i AND CommandLine=/--paths/i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])])
ucs.rationale: The '--access-token' execution gate is a defining, well-documented ALPHV/BlackCat encryptor feature (Microsoft, Sophos, Mandiant) that does not appear in generic ransomware; pairing it with the family's specific '--propagation'/'--no-prop-servers'/'--no-wall' flags and concurrent shadow-copy/symlink recovery inhibition makes this fire on BlackCat specifically rather than ransomware broadly.

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat pre-encryption propagation: PsExec service execution + fsutil R2R/R2L symlink enablement
ucs.description: Hunts BlackCat's documented lateral-movement-to-impact chain where operators flip 'fsutil behavior set SymlinkEvaluation R2R:1 R2L:1' to let the encryptor traverse remote shares, then push the payload across hosts via PsExec-installed services (PSEXESVC) and admin shares. The symlink-evaluation toggle immediately preceding PsExec service creation is a characteristic ALPHV staging behavior.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="fsutil.exe" AND Processes.process="*SymlinkEvaluation*" AND (Processes.process="*R2R*" OR Processes.process="*R2L*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$")
| join type=inner dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="PsExec.exe" OR Processes.process="*-accepteula*" OR Processes.process_name="PSEXESVC.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="PSEXESVC.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process as psexec_process]
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process psexec_process
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Symlink = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "fsutil.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "SymlinkEvaluation"
          and (ProcessCommandLine has "R2R" or ProcessCommandLine has "R2L")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, SymlinkTime = Timestamp, SymlinkCmd = ProcessCommandLine, AccountName, DeviceName;
let PsExecProp = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "PSEXESVC.exe"
         or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "PSEXESVC.exe"
         or (FileName =~ "PsExec.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "accepteula")
         or ProcessCommandLine has @"\\" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-accepteula","-s -d")
    | project DeviceId, PsExecTime = Timestamp, PsExecCmd = ProcessCommandLine, PsExecFile = FileName;
Symlink
| join kind=inner PsExecProp on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', PsExecTime, SymlinkTime)) <= 60   // 60m = staging-to-propagation window observed in ALPHV intrusions
| project SymlinkTime, PsExecTime, DeviceName, AccountName, SymlinkCmd, PsExecFile, PsExecCmd
| order by SymlinkTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Symlink = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "fsutil.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "SymlinkEvaluation" and (CommandLine has "R2R" or CommandLine has "R2L")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project Computer, SymlinkTime = TimeGenerated, SymlinkCmd = CommandLine, SubjectUserName;
let PsExecProp = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where (EventID == 4688 and (NewProcessName endswith "PSEXESVC.exe" or ParentProcessName endswith "PSEXESVC.exe" or (NewProcessName endswith "PsExec.exe" and CommandLine has "accepteula")))
         or (EventID == 7045 and ServiceName has "PSEXESVC")
    | project Computer, PsExecTime = TimeGenerated, PsExecCmd = CommandLine, PsExecSvc = ServiceName;
Symlink
| join kind=inner PsExecProp on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', PsExecTime, SymlinkTime)) <= 60
| project SymlinkTime, PsExecTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, SymlinkCmd, PsExecCmd, PsExecSvc
| order by SymlinkTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat fsutil Remote SymlinkEvaluation Enablement
id: a91f3c27-5e8d-4b6a-9c12-7d4e2f8b30c5
status: experimental
description: Detects the fsutil SymlinkEvaluation R2R/R2L toggle used by ALPHV/BlackCat operators to enable encryption across remote shares.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2022/07/14/blackcat-ransomware-attacks-not-merely-a-byproduct-of-bad-luck/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\fsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'SymlinkEvaluation'
  modifier:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'R2R'
      - 'R2L'
  condition: selection and modifier
falsepositives:
  - Rare administrative DFS/symlink troubleshooting
level: high
tags:
  - attack.lateral-movement
  - attack.t1021.002
  - attack.t1486
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) ((@Image:(*\fsutil.exe OR *\FSUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*SymlinkEvaluation* AND (@CommandLine:*R2R* OR @CommandLine:*R2L*)) OR (@Image:(*\PSEXESVC.exe OR *\psexesvc.exe) OR @ParentImage:(*\PSEXESVC.exe OR *\psexesvc.exe)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/fsutil\.exe/i AND CommandLine=/SymlinkEvaluation/i AND CommandLine=/R2R|R2L/i) OR ImageFileName=/psexesvc\.exe/i OR ParentBaseFileName=/psexesvc\.exe/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(), collect([ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine])])
| count > 1
ucs.rationale: The 'fsutil behavior set SymlinkEvaluation R2R:1 R2L:1' command is a documented ALPHV/BlackCat staging step that legitimate operations almost never perform, and pairing it within a 60-minute window with PSEXESVC-driven propagation captures the family's signature lateral-movement-to-impact sequence rather than generic PsExec usage.
